title: Meaning and purpose
learning_outcomes: Explain meaning and purpose in the context of meaning and purpose.
Compare and distinguish cultural variation in the context of meaning and purpose.
Apply values and contribution in the context of meaning and purpose.
Evaluate and justify decisions about adaptable projects in the context of meaning and purpose.

lessons.title: Meaning and purpose
lessons.outcome: Explain meaning and purpose in the context of meaning and purpose.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving meaning and purpose; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Create an annotated explanation with a concrete example and a counterexample. Connect the result to values-to-action proposal.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain meaning and purpose from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of meaning and purpose; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

lessons.title: Cultural variation
lessons.outcome: Compare and distinguish cultural variation in the context of meaning and purpose.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving cultural variation; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Compare two cases or approaches using explicit criteria; identify an important limitation. Connect the result to values-to-action proposal.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain cultural variation from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of cultural variation; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

lessons.title: Values and contribution
lessons.outcome: Apply values and contribution in the context of meaning and purpose.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving values and contribution; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Work through a new case or simulation; document assumptions and steps. Connect the result to values-to-action proposal.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain values and contribution from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of values and contribution; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

lessons.title: Adaptable projects
lessons.outcome: Evaluate and justify decisions about adaptable projects in the context of meaning and purpose.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving adaptable projects; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Analyse an unfamiliar case; defend a choice, identify uncertainty and revise after feedback. Connect the result to values-to-action proposal.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain adaptable projects from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of adaptable projects; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

criteria.criterion: Accurate explanation of meaning and purpose; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.
Accurate explanation of cultural variation; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.
Accurate explanation of values and contribution; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.
Accurate explanation of adaptable projects; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

assessment.threshold: All mapped criteria at level 2; no averaging away missing criteria. Level 3 requires independent novel application, delayed reassessment and appropriate review.
assessment.alternate_evidence: Equivalent accessible written, oral, visual, simulated or supervised evidence; no personal disclosure required.

safety.notes: Draft educational framework only. Use fictional cases; no personal diagnosis, prescription, hazardous practice, financial/legal instruction or unqualified certification. Obtain qualified/local review before publication.
